name: 36602 · Mobile, AL
findings: ZIP 36602 (Mobile) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36602 (Mobile) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36602 (Mobile) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
